templatePrecedence: Product components use independent included builds and flatten into final Target JARs, replacing prior nested-JAR packaging.
Instances use instances.toml/local.toml and the template merge/default policy, replacing the previous properties cascade.
The template-supplied specification workflow is retained despite the former repository rule against implicit CI.
No root build.gradle.kts: coordination is performed by the template settings plugins.
Template defaults provide DevPlayer/DevGuest; the old requirement to explicitly configure a second player name is replaced.
